name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the single hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is the literal 'at every moment ... then, or later' rule. Each step with the ball out of the way owes the key on that step or later, and the compiled machine tracks exactly that. The final box pickup leaves the hands full, so a run that finishes with the ball still out of the way and no key in hand ends owing the key. This follows from the task's own wording, not from a clause error.

texts: At every moment the blocking ball is out of the way of the door, the agent must be carrying the matching key at that moment or pick it up at some later moment.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
